verdict.rationale: Gitea is a free, self-hosted, MIT-licensed service offering "full control" (gitea-docs-30). It stores data in standard databases such as SQLite, MySQL and PostgreSQL (gitea-docs-14), and exposes an API (gitea-docs-4), so the user owns the data in open, accessible stores. However, the evidence documents no explicit user-facing export or dump feature, and one community question about whether backup/restore is adequate (gitea-comm-20) is unanswered rather than contradicted. Missing for 10: a documented export/backup tool covering issues, PRs, wikis and other metadata, a description of export formats, and hands-on corroboration of a complete exit path.
